justification: A depicts a naturalistic human head in profile with elaborate patterned beard, headdress and earring, while B shows only abstract incised geometry — interlocking hatched triangles and zigzags covering the whole surface with no figure at all. The only correspondence is the generic habit of filling areas with dense parallel hatching, which any tradition could arrive at independently.
